ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Find out why a stock search returned nothing
ux.finding: Stock search can never tell the user that it failed. The editor's stock client swallows every non-abort error and returns an empty array, and the server returns an empty array when its provider keys are unset — so 'this deployment has no Pexels/Unsplash key', 'the key expired', 'the network dropped' and 'there really are no photos of that' all render as the same silent empty grid. The failure state the code was written to show is unreachable.
ux.evidence: StockService.ts:80-83 and :94-97 — both search methods `catch { ... return []; }`. server/services/stock.service.ts:55-56 `const key = process.env.UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY; if (!key || !query.trim()) return [];` and :102-103 the same for PEXELS_API_KEY. useDiscoveryState.ts:117-124 sets searchFailed + toasts 'Discovery search failed' only from a rejected promise, which StockService prevents. StockService.ts:54-57 admits it in a comment: 'A real configured-ness signal needs a server capability endpoint.' Searched: 'searchFailed', 'IS_STOCK_CONFIGURED', 'stockService', 'searchStockPhotos', 'PEXELS_API_KEY'.
ux.fix: Stock needs a configured-ness signal from the server and a distinct error state in the UI: 'Stock search isn't set up on this site' is a different screen from 'No photos match beach', and only one of them is worth a retry button.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Know which of my files will actually appear on the published site
ux.finding: An asset that never reached the server — the upload mirror failed, or the blob token is missing — is warned about exactly twice, in two toasts that auto-dismiss: once at upload, once at insert. The grid tile itself carries no marker. A user who scrolls back an hour later cannot tell a device-only file from a real one, and placing it produces an element that renders nothing and publishes nothing.
ux.evidence: AssetCell.tsx:64 `const badge = item.assetSource ? BADGE[item.assetSource] : undefined;` — the tile's only badge is provenance (stock/upload source), not localOnly. useUploadState.ts:121-127 and useMediaState.ts:268-277 are the two toast sites. Searched AssetCell.tsx for 'localOnly', 'offline', 'device' — no matches; grep 'localOnly' across media/ hits useMediaState.ts, useUploadState.ts, mediaTypes.ts only.
ux.fix: Mark the tile. A device-only asset needs a persistent badge in the grid and a line in the detail screen with the action that fixes it (re-upload), not two toasts that are gone in five seconds.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Rename an asset, copy its URL, move it to a folder, or delete just this one file
ux.finding: Right-clicking an asset in the Media drawer does not open a menu — it silently switches the whole panel into bulk-selection mode. The per-asset menu that would carry Rename, Copy URL, Copy alt text, Move to folder, Edit image, Replace across pages and Delete exists and is finished, but nothing in the drawer mounts it. So on the default Media surface there is NO way to rename a file, no way to copy its URL, and no way to move or delete a single asset without first entering a bulk mode you did not ask for.
ux.evidence: MediaTab.tsx:16 imports MediaContextMenu and never renders it (grep of MediaTab.tsx: 1 occurrence, the import line). useMediaState.ts:342-344 returns ctxMenu/openCtxMenu/closeCtxMenu; grep across src for 'openCtxMenu', 'ctxMenu', 'MediaContextMenu' outside __tests__ returns only useMediaState + LibraryManager.tsx:495. SlimLauncher.tsx:469-476 wires onContextMenu -> props.onEnterSelection, and MediaTab.tsx:352-355 maps that to toggleSelMode+toggleSelect. Searched: 'openCtxMenu', 'ctxMenu', 'MediaContextMenu', 'onContextMenu', 'contextmenu'.
ux.fix: Restore a per-asset menu on right-click in the drawer (the component is already built and already mounted in the fullpage manager), and give bulk selection its own visible entry — a Select control in the folder row — rather than stealing the right-click gesture for it.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Search stock photos from the sidebar
ux.finding: The drawer's stock browser is not wired to the failure flag at all, so even after UX-H-02 is fixed the drawer would still show a blank grid. The failure prop exists and is only passed to the other stock surface — the one that lives in the fullpage manager.
ux.evidence: MediaTab.tsx:378-392 mounts StockBrowserOverlay with onClose/photos/videos/loading/searchQuery/orientation/color/onSearch/onSetOrientation/onSetColor/onLoadMore/onSave and no failure prop; StockBrowserOverlayProps (StockBrowserOverlay.tsx:26-38) declares none. MediaTab.tsx:243 passes searchFailed={state.searchFailed} to StockSourceModal instead. Searched: 'searchFailed', 'StockBrowserOverlay', 'onSearch'.
ux.fix: Give the drawer's stock overlay the same three-way result state as the modal: results / genuinely empty / could not reach the provider.

ux.screen: Media drawer · Browse stock overlay vs fullpage Library · Stock modal
ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Place a stock photo on the page
ux.finding: There are two different stock browsers with different powers, and which one you get depends on which Media surface you happened to open. The drawer's overlay can only SAVE a photo into the library — you then have to find it in the grid and click it again to place it. The fullpage manager's modal can insert straight onto the canvas, switch provider, filter by colour, and browse icons and fonts. Nothing tells the user the other one exists.
ux.evidence: StockBrowserOverlay.tsx:148 — the only per-cell action is `onClick={() => onSave(type, item)}`; its props (StockBrowserOverlay.tsx:26-38) carry no onInsert. MediaTab.tsx:232-249 passes onInsert={state.insertToCanvas} and onOpenIconPicker to StockSourceModal. StockBrowserOverlay.tsx:10-12 states the split in its own header comment. Searched: 'onInsert', 'onSave', 'StockSourceModal', 'StockBrowserOverlay'.
ux.fix: One stock browser. If the drawer must be narrower, it should be the same component at a smaller size with the same actions, not a second surface missing the primary verb (place it on the page).

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Browse the full icon library, or switch stock provider
ux.finding: A 395-line stock modal is mounted in the Media drawer behind a flag that is never turned on. Its open state is initialised false and the only call to its setter sets it to false again, so the provider switch, the colour swatches, the Icons and Fonts tabs and its 'Browse full icon library' door render for nobody in the sidebar — along with the icon-picker callback chain that hangs off it.
ux.evidence: MediaTab.tsx:73 `const [stockModalOpen, setStockModalOpen] = React.useState(false);`; MediaTab.tsx:234 `onClose={() => setStockModalOpen(false)}` is the only other reference (grep of 'setStockModalOpen' in MediaTab.tsx returns 2 lines, both shown). MediaTab.tsx:210-224 defines handleOpenIconPicker and passes it only to that modal at :248. The drawer's Icons link instead opens IconBrowserOverlay (MediaTab.tsx:366, :393-405). Searched: 'stockModalOpen', 'setStockModalOpen', 'StockSourceModal', 'onOpenIconPicker'.
ux.fix: Delete the unreachable mount or give it a door. Whichever survives, the Icons and Fonts entry points should sit in the same place as Upload and Browse stock — the footer — instead of being reachable only through the fullpage manager.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Upload a photo from my phone or a video from my camera
ux.finding: The file picker offers more formats than the product can store. The upload zone accepts any image/* and any video/*, so an iPhone HEIC photo, a .avi or an .mkv are all selectable and all start uploading; the server's allow-list is a closed set of eight formats and rejects them at the token step. The user finds out their photo is the wrong format only after choosing it, from a server error, with no statement anywhere of what is actually supported.
ux.evidence: UploadZone.tsx:15 `ACCEPT_TYPES = "image/*,video/*,.ttf,.otf,.woff,.woff2,.svg"` and :17-23 isAccepted() returns true for any file whose type starts image/ or video/. packages/dashboard/app/api/asset-upload/route.ts:31-49 ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES is png, jpeg, gif, webp, avif, svg+xml, mp4, webm, quicktime plus font types. Searched: 'ACCEPT_TYPES', 'isAccepted', 'ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES', 'image/heic', 'video/quicktime'.
ux.fix: Make the picker's accept-list and the client-side check the same closed list the server enforces, and name the supported formats in the upload zone before the user picks — reject at choose-time with the format named, not after a round trip.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Organise a growing library into folders
ux.finding: The drawer's folder scope button is disabled whenever the library has no folders, and the drawer has no way to create one — folder creation lives only in the fullpage manager's folder rail. So a user working in the sidebar sees a folder control that will never enable and a bulk 'Move to…' picker whose only entry is (Root), with no hint that folders exist or where to make one.
ux.evidence: SlimLauncher.tsx:255 `disabled={(props.allFolders?.length ?? 0) === 0}` on the folder scope Button; SlimLauncher.tsx:536-548 the bulk Move-to menu renders '(Root)' plus flattenFolderTree(props.allFolders ?? []). state.createFolder is passed only at LibraryManager.tsx:354 into FolderTree, whose 'New folder' input is FolderTree.tsx:378. Searched: 'createFolder', 'onAddFolder', 'New Folder', 'allFolders'.
ux.fix: Put New folder in the drawer's own folder menu. A disabled scope control with no reachable way to enable it is worse than no control.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Sort the library, or switch to a list view to read filenames
ux.finding: Three controls in the drawer's folder row — Grid view, List view, Sort — are rendered permanently disabled with no tooltip and no explanation. The code says they will light up in a later task. Grid view is also drawn pressed, so the row reads as a working segmented control where two of three options simply refuse to respond. The library's sort order and sort direction are real state that nothing in the drawer can reach.
ux.evidence: SlimLauncher.tsx:285-293 — three IconButtons, all `disabled`, the first also `pressed`; the block comment at :281-282 says 'They light up with the folder work (T12).' useMediaState.ts:363-364 exposes sort/sortDir and :372 setSort, wired nowhere in SlimLauncher. Searched: 'setSort', 'sortDir', 'List view', 'ArrowUpDown', 'disabled'.
ux.fix: Either wire them or remove them. If they must stay, each disabled control needs a reason on hover — the repo's own Button rule says a disabled control without a stated reason is a bug.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Write alt text for an image so the published page is accessible
ux.finding: The '✨ Generate' button for alt text fails in total silence. If the AI provider is unconfigured or the call errors, the label flips to 'Generating…', flips back to 'Generate', the field stays empty, and nothing is said. A user who presses it twice and gets nothing has no way to learn whether the feature is broken, off, or just slow.
ux.evidence: AssetDetailOverlay.tsx:270-289 — `try { const alt = await generateContent(...) } catch { /* AI unavailable — the field stays manual. */ } finally { setAltBusy(false) }`; the catch body is a comment only. Root CLAUDE.md documents that without OPENAI_API_KEY every AI job fails on 'Missing credentials'. Searched: 'generateAlt', 'generateContent', 'altBusy', 'media-alt-generate'.
ux.fix: Say what happened: an inline error under the field, or hide the Generate affordance entirely when AI is not configured. A magic button that does nothing teaches the user to distrust every other button on the panel.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Open a file, look at it, then rename or delete it
ux.finding: The asset drill-in — the one screen entirely about a single file — offers no rename, no delete, no download and no copy-URL. Its five rows are Used in N places, Versions, Edit image, Optimise and Replace across site. Combined with the missing context menu (UX-H-01), a user who opens a file in the drawer, decides the name is wrong and wants it gone has to leave for the fullpage manager to do either.
ux.evidence: AssetDetailOverlay.tsx:415-465 — the hub renders exactly five Buttons: media-detail-used, media-detail-versions, media-detail-edit, media-detail-optimize, media-detail-replace. Searched inside AssetDetailOverlay.tsx for 'Rename', 'Delete', 'Download', 'Copy URL', 'copyUrl' — no matches. useMediaState.ts:379-381 exposes renameItem and copyUrl; neither reaches this component.
ux.fix: The detail screen is the natural home for rename, delete and download. Put them there, and let the file's name itself be the editable field.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: See more of my library than two columns of the sidebar
ux.finding: The drawer's expand brackets do not widen the drawer — they close it and open a different, fullscreen screen with its own grid, folder rail, toolbar, context menu and stock modal. The user asked for more room and got a different application surface, and everything they could not do in the drawer (rename, folders, sort, single-asset delete) silently becomes possible there with no signposting that this is where those actions live.
ux.evidence: useMediaState.ts:48-53 setPanelExpanded emits ui:media-panel-width; MediaTab.tsx:92-96 turns any panelExpanded signal into `state.setPanelExpanded(false); onOpenLibrary();`. MediaTab.tsx:87-91 block comment: 'every expand signal (the header brackets, the upload auto-expand) opens the fullpage manager instead.' MediaTab.tsx:333 wires onExpand to setPanelExpanded(true). Searched: 'panelExpanded', 'onOpenLibrary', 'setPanelExpanded', 'ui:media-panel-width'.
ux.fix: Name the destination. If the fullpage manager is the real Media home, the drawer should say so and the actions that only exist there should be visible-but-redirecting in the drawer, rather than absent.

ux.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
ux.task: Stop an upload I started by mistake, or clear a stuck row
ux.finding: An upload in flight in the drawer cannot be cancelled or dismissed. Each in-progress row shows a filename, a percentage and a bar, and no control at all. A 48MB video picked by accident occupies the footer until it finishes or fails; the dismiss handler exists but is only wired in the fullpage manager.
ux.evidence: UploadZone.tsx:163-192 renders activeItems as li rows containing only the name, the percent and a progressbar — no button. Failed rows get a Retry (UploadZone.tsx:225-238) but no dismiss. state.dismissUpload is passed only at LibraryManager.tsx:379 (grep 'dismissUpload' across src outside __tests__ returns that one line plus useMediaState/useUploadState). Searched: 'dismissUpload', 'onDismissUpload', 'cancel', 'abort'.
ux.fix: Every in-flight row needs a cancel; every terminal row needs a dismiss. Both in the drawer, where the upload was started.

summary.purpose: Media is where a site's images, video, icons and fonts are uploaded, organised, described and placed on the canvas.
summary.finding: PURPOSE: hold every non-text asset a site uses and get it onto the page. PRIMARY TASKS: upload files; find an asset (search, type pills, folders, load-more paging); place it on the canvas by click or drag; describe it (alt text); replace one asset with another across the whole site; optimise or edit an image; delete safely. ENTRY POINTS: the rail's Media tab (MediaTab -> SlimLauncher at 320); the header expand brackets, which do not widen the drawer but open the fullpage LibraryManager instead (MediaTab.tsx:92-96); and two engine events that push the user in from elsewhere — `ui:media-selection-request` and `element:needs-asset`, both of which emit `ui:switch-tab` to 'assets' and pre-filter the panel (useMediaState.ts:117-155). EXIT POINTS: inserting emits `ui:switch-tab` back to 'add' in selection mode (useMediaState.ts:240); the drill-in's Used-in view jumps to a page and element on the canvas; Close on the panel header. HANDS OFF TO: canvas (insertMediaAt / replaceMedia via composer.mediaOps), inspector (a placed image's own properties), pages (the used-in jump), publish (localOnly assets never reach it). RECEIVES FROM: canvas/build (the empty-media-element contract that opens the picker), inspector (media-selection-request), the dashboard's asset-upload route and the stock proxy. THE STRUCTURAL PROBLEM: the module has two surfaces with unequal powers — a 320 drawer that is the default and a fullpage manager that holds rename, folders, sort, single-asset delete, the richer stock browser and the context menu — and nothing in the drawer names the second one or explains why an action is missing.
summary.evidence: MediaTab.tsx:83-96 and :299-306 (the fullpage branch is unreachable from this component); useMediaState.ts:117-155 (the two inbound events); LibraryManager.tsx:354-379, :467-468, :495 (the actions only it wires). Searched: 'ui:switch-tab', 'ui:media-selection-request', 'element:needs-asset', 'onOpenLibrary', 'MEDIA_EVENTS'.
summary.fix: Make one Media surface canonical and let the other be a size of it. Every action the drawer cannot perform should either be present there or visibly point at where it lives.
